basics.name: Dr. Mengya Xu
basics.label: Robotics Researcher & PhD in SLAM
basics.summary: 🎓 Passionate robotics researcher specializing in simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), active SLAM, and deformable SLAM. Dedicated to advancing autonomous systems through innovative filter-based algorithms and machine learning approaches.

work.name: 🏛️ University of Technology Sydney
work.summary: Developing cutting-edge extended Kalman filter based algorithms for simultaneous localization and mapping in challenging deformable environments, including medical robotics applications.

work.name: 🏛️ Southern University of Science and Technology
work.summary: Pioneered reinforcement learning based path planning solutions and developed runtime safety assurance systems for autonomous driving applications.

courses: 🔬 Filter-based Active SLAM in Static and Deformable Environments
